==Description==
'''D-5''' is a basic fallback entity, of which is compromised of simply one eyeball.

==Mechanic==
<tabber>
|-|Current=
'''Current'''<br>
When '''D-5''' spawns, 3 bangs will be emitted from the door, meaning '''D-5''' is behind it. Shortly after, it will move out from the door, moving backwards through the rooms while making footstep sounds.
'''D-5''' will continue to move until he has moved 5 rooms backwards, at which point a short piece of music will play as he despawns.
Any player seen by D-5, regardless of distance will be damaged rapidly, so it is recommended to stay hiding until D-5 despawns
If the player shoots D-5 many times, D-5 will start breaking the door shotly after spawning, meaning that it is angered.
If the player keeps shooting D-5 even when it is angered, [[D-5i]] will eventually replace '''D-5''', [[D-5i]] will mimic D-5 once spawned this way, knocking on the door, but will immediately break the door down after the second knock.

|-|Invasion=
'''Invasion'''<br>
Once It spawns, it will bang on the door, placing itself behind it before walking back, once far enough back, it will play a fake despawn sound before Zooming back to the main room, despawning when it reaches the door, any player caught by D-5 will be instantly killed.
</tabber>

==Strategy & Tips==
* '''D-5''' Disables [[Claustrophobia]] while it is active, use this to your advantage, especially when there are other entities present.
* When '''D-5''' is angered, you should instantly hide if it spawn in the same room as [[D-120]], because '''D-5''' will break the door, skipping the whole [[D-120]] cooldown before fallbacking. Or maybe even stop shooting D-5 to avoid [[D-5i]].

==Trivia==
* '''D-5'''<nowiki/>'s line of sight is infinite, just like [[D-5i]]'s.
** How<nowiki/>ever, if '''D-20''' spawns on its path, it will block the sight of '''D-5''', meaning it won't harm the player if it gets out because of its line of sight beeing blocked off
* '''D-5''', [[D-55]], and [[M-134]] are the only naturally spawning entities from '''OG RFF''' that haven't gotten their Designs changed since they were first released
